title: Guild cover & light-competition correctness (§4.47)
simLoop: Overlapping guild cover fractions combine by product-complement 1 − Π(1 − cᵢ) instead of an additive clamp; leaf-area index is the Beer–Lambert-consistent inverse LAI = −ln(1 − cover)/k so transmitted light is exactly I₀(1 − cover) and approaches darkness at full cover; legacy cover growth reads the light absorbed across the open fraction, dropping the squared self-shading double-count.
gameLoop: Three pioneer guilds at 40% each read as 0.78 combined cover, not a saturated 1.0, so extra biomass keeps a physical effect on roughness/infiltration and a full canopy no longer rests on a light floor; regrowth into gaps is no longer doubly suppressed.
notebookSeed: A second guild moving into a stand adds cover the way a second sheet of shade does — most of the ground is already taken — and a closed canopy really does go dark underneath.
tierO: no owner-only question — product-complement combination and the Beer–Lambert-consistent LAI are CI-judged against named numeric edge cases (0.4×3 → 0.784; full cover → zero transmitted light). Does not implement C-023.
